actions.reason: RegexTokenizer.train scanned all pair counts every merge (list(stats.values()) + max + count). Replaced with the existing lazy max-heap helper pop_top_pairs (already used by BasicTokenizer): new pairs (which are the only ones whose count rises) are pushed after each merge, decreased/deleted entries are fixed lazily. Ties still go through the same earliest-occurrence (chunk, position) tie-break, which is order-independent, so merges are identical. train_ir ratio 0.8727, equivalence identical, tests pass.
